# state-message API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Section states with caller copy, optional artwork and explicit actions.

## StateMessage

Replace a bounded section with a state explanation, decorative artwork and optional actions.
Reuses FormattedText, Fluent buttons and useSx container layout; requires no SPFx provider.
The nearest Fluent theme selects light/dark artwork by foreground/background luminance,
with a light fallback for absent or uninterpretable tokens. Custom visual overrides it.
Text/action widths follow the toolkit medium (640px) container breakpoint.
Artwork has fluid width up to 280px and natural height from its SVG aspect ratio.
Children of the text region must be semantically valid phrasing content. No autofocus.

### Imports

```ts
import { StateMessage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { StateMessage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { StateMessage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/state-message';
```

### Use when

- A section needs an empty, error or completion state with optional artwork and explicit actions.

### Avoid when

- Use FormattedText for ordinary text without state semantics or illustration/actions.

### Examples

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { StateMessage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const clearFilters = (): void => { console.log('Clear filters requested'); };
<StateMessage preset="empty" title="No results" description="Try **other filters**."
  primaryAction={{ label: 'Clear filters', onClick: clearFilters }} />
```

### Signatures

```ts
(props: StateMessageProps & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | null
```

#### Parameters

- `props`: Native div attributes, localized content, preset and button/link intentions.

#### Returns

The div root containing text, optional artwork and actions outside the live region.

## ActionBase

Shared native Fluent Button attributes with label/icon content, excluding shell-owned
appearance, size, shape, root tag and children. The concrete action selects button or anchor
attributes; label slots are literal phrasing content and callback output remains caller-owned.

Source-owned support type; no public named import.

### Examples (2)

```ts
import { StateMessageClickAction } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const label: StateMessageClickAction = { label: 'Retry', disabled: true, onClick: () => console.log('Retry') };
```

### Type parameters

- `Props`: Native Fluent button or anchor props inherited by the concrete action.

### Type

```ts
type ActionBase<Props> = Omit<Props,
  'appearance' | 'as' | 'children' | 'href' | 'icon' | 'onClick' | 'shape' | 'size' | 'type' | 'dangerouslySetInnerHTML'
> & {
  /**
   * Literal phrasing content or span props/render slot inside the owned Button. No nested interactive elements; ref targets the inner span.
   */
  label: ContentSlot<'span'>;
  /**
   * Optional native Fluent Button icon slot; omitted actions have no icon.
   */
  icon?: ButtonProps['icon'];
  /**
   * Unsupported: label is the sole content pathway.
   * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
   */
  dangerouslySetInnerHTML?: never;
}
```

## StateMessageClickAction

Callback action rendered as a native button with type=button.

### Imports (3)

```ts
import type { StateMessageClickAction } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { StateMessageClickAction } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { StateMessageClickAction } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/state-message';
```

### Examples (4)

```ts
import { StateMessageClickAction } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const action: StateMessageClickAction = { label: 'Retry', onClick: () => console.log('Retry requested') };
```

### Type (3)

```ts
type StateMessageClickAction = ActionBase<Exclude<ButtonProps, {
  /**
   * Type filter excluding anchor props; the action owns its button root.
   */
  as: 'a'
}>> & {
  /**
   * Navigation destinations belong to link actions.
   * Must be omitted or undefined in this branch.
   */
  href?: never;
  /**
   * Called for native button activation with the React mouse event. No automatic
   * loading, awaiting or error handling is added; the application owns asynchronous work.
   */
  onClick: React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>;
}
```

## StateMessageLinkAction

Navigation action rendered as a Fluent Button with a native anchor root.

### Imports (5)

```ts
import type { StateMessageLinkAction } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { StateMessageLinkAction } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { StateMessageLinkAction } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/state-message';
```

### Examples (6)

```ts
import { StateMessageLinkAction } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
const action: StateMessageLinkAction = { label: 'Help', href: '/help' };
```

### Type (5)

```ts
type StateMessageLinkAction = ActionBase<Extract<ButtonProps, {
  /**
   * Type filter selecting native anchor props; consumers supply href instead of as.
   */
  as: 'a'
}>> & {
  /**
   * Destination assigned to the anchor.
   */
  href: string;
  /**
   * Browsing context for navigation; when omitted, uses the current context.
   */
  target?: React.HTMLAttributeAnchorTarget;
  /**
   * Native link relationship; when omitted, adds no toolkit relationship tokens.
   */
  rel?: string;
  /**
   * Optional native anchor activation callback receiving the React mouse event.
   * Prevent the event to cancel native navigation; any asynchronous return is not awaited.
   * When omitted, native link navigation runs without a consumer activation callback.
   */
  onClick?: React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLAnchorElement>;
}
```

## StateMessagePreset

Selects decorative artwork and announcement defaults, without supplying application copy.
`empty`, `error` and `success` use `status`; `generic` and `welcome` have no default role.

## StateMessageProps

Bounded section state composed from toolkit text, Fluent buttons and private artwork.
Uses the host Fluent theme/Griffel renderer without an SPFx provider. Named slots use
fixed tags; object refs target inner containers and render callbacks must forward their
composed props. Omit optional actions/content to leave their regions absent.

### Imports (7)

```ts
import type { StateMessageProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { StateMessageProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { StateMessageProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/state-message';
```

### Examples (8)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { StateMessage } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<StateMessage preset="empty" title="No results" description="Try **other filters**." />
```

### Type (7)

```ts
interface StateMessageProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title" | "dangerouslySetInnerHTML" | "role" | "children">
```

### Members (7)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `StateMessageProps.dangerouslySetInnerHTML` | `never` | Forbidden | — | Unsupported: title and description are the owned content pathways.<br>Must be omitted or undefined in this branch. |
| `StateMessageProps.description` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Optional span content slot inside p. Static strings/fragments retain inline Markdown; render callbacks are opaque and own formatting. Ref targets the inner span.<br>When omitted, no supporting description region is rendered. |
| `StateMessageProps.headingLevel` | `StateMessageHeadingLevel \| undefined` | Optional | 3 | Title HTML heading level, default 3. Choose it for the surrounding document hierarchy.<br>When omitted, defaults to 3. |
| `StateMessageProps.preset` | `StateMessagePreset \| undefined` | Optional | — | Optional artwork/announcement preset. When omitted, renders no automatic illustration or role. |
| `StateMessageProps.primaryAction` | `StateMessageAction \| undefined` | Optional | — | Highest-emphasis action, with primary appearance.<br>When omitted, no primary action is rendered. |
| `StateMessageProps.role` | `StateMessageRole \| undefined` | Optional | — | Text-region role override. Empty/error/success when omitted, defaults to status; alert must be explicit. |
| `StateMessageProps.secondaryAction` | `StateMessageAction \| undefined` | Optional | — | Supporting action, with secondary appearance.<br>When omitted, no secondary action is rendered. |
| `StateMessageProps.tertiaryAction` | `StateMessageAction \| undefined` | Optional | — | Lowest-emphasis action, with subtle appearance.<br>When omitted, no tertiary action is rendered. |
| `StateMessageProps.title` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Required | — | Required literal phrasing content or span props/render slot inside the owned heading. Strings are not Markdown; ref targets the inner span. |
| `StateMessageProps.visual` | `ContentSlot<"div">` | Optional | — | Replaces preset artwork; false hides it, undefined uses the preset. Custom div props/render slots retain their semantics; ref targets the inner div. |
